## [Publications](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=CtWNkOkAAAAJ&hl=en&oi=sra)

As of `r Sys.Date()`: Total citations (302), h-index (8), i10-index (8).\
ORCID: [0000-0003-1223-8588](https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1223-8588)\
\*Published on a pre-print server.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pubs_all <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(xlsxFile = "csv/pubs.xlsx", sheet = 3)
pubs_all$Year <- as.character(pubs_all$Year)

# Escape characters that have special meaning in HTML; turn NA into ""
html_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x), "", as.character(x))
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}

# Link a DOI, whether stored as "10.xxxx/..." or a full https://doi.org/ URL
doi_link <- function(doi) {
  doi <- ifelse(is.na(doi), "", trimws(doi))
  url <- ifelse(grepl("^https?://", doi), doi, paste0("https://doi.org/", doi))
  ifelse(doi == "", "",
         paste0('<a href="', url, '" target="_blank">', html_escape(doi), '</a>'))
}

pubs_all$Citation <- paste(
  html_escape(pubs_all$Authors),
  html_escape(pubs_all$Title),
  ifelse(is.na(pubs_all$Journal), "",
         paste0("<em>", html_escape(pubs_all$Journal), "</em>")),
  html_escape(pubs_all$Volume),
  doi_link(pubs_all$DOI)
)
pubs_all$Citation <- str_squish(pubs_all$Citation)
pubs_all$Citation <- gsub("Scaggs, S. A.", "<strong>Scaggs, S. A.</strong>",
                          pubs_all$Citation, fixed = TRUE)

# One function draws every publication table
pubs_table <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  df |>
    arrange(desc(Year)) |>
    select(Year, Citation) |>
    kbl(format = "html", escape = FALSE, col.names = NULL, align = "l") |>
    kable_styling(full_width = TRUE) |>
    column_spec(1, width = "1in")
}

unpublished <- c("In prep", "Under review", "Submitted")

pubs_all |>
  filter(!Year %in% unpublished, !str_detect(Year, fixed("*"))) |>
  pubs_table()
```

```{r, message=F, warning=F, fig.width=8, fig.height=4, fig.cap="Contribution matrix.", include=F}
cont <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("C:/Users/scaggs.32/OneDrive - The Ohio State University (1)/BuckeyeOneDriveMigrated/Professional/sascaggs.github.io/csv/pubs.xlsx", sheet=2)

cont %>% 
  gather(key=key, value=value, -Contribution) %>%
  mutate(value = ifelse(is.na(value)==T, 'No', 'Yes')) %>%
  ggplot() + geom_tile(aes(x=key, y=Contribution, fill=factor(value)), color='black',size=1) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('white','magenta')) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color='black'),
        text = element_text(size=14, color='black')) + 
  labs(x=NULL, y=NULL, fill='Contributed?') 
```
